title: DORA Explorer: Improving the Exploration Ability of LLMs Without Training
abstract: arXiv:2604.17244v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents for sequential decision-making struggle to produce diverse outputs. This leads to insufficient exploration, suboptimal solutions, and repeated actions. Actions are generated at the sequence level, but existing sampling strategies, such as temperature scaling, introduce diversity at the token level, not at the sequence level. We introduce DORA EXPLORER (Diversity-Oriented Ranking of Actions), a training-free, inference-time algorithm for improving exploration in LLM agents. DORA generates multiple candidate actions, scores them using sequence-level log-probability statistics, and samples an action via a tunable exploration parameter. We first study exploration in the classic Multi-Armed Bandit setting, where DORA substantially outperforms temperature-based sampling. translated_title: DORA探索者：无需训练提升大语言模型的探索能力
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.17244v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：用于顺序决策的大语言模型（LLM）代理难以产生多样化的输出。这导致探索不足、解决方案次优以及重复动作。动作是在序列级别生成的，但现有的采样策略（如温度缩放）在令牌级别而非序列级别引入多样性。我们引入了DORA探索者（基于多样性的动作排序），这是一种无需训练、推理时的算法，用于改进LLM代理的探索能力。DORA生成多个候选动作，使用序列级别的对数概率统计对其进行评分，并通过可调的探索参数采样一个动作。我们首先在经典的多臂老虎机设置中研究探索，其中DORA显著优于基于温度的采样。我们的主要评估在文本冒险学习环境套件（TALES）上进行，其中提示策略无法探索，但DORA成功实现了探索。
tldr: DORA探索者提出了一种无需训练、推理时的方法，通过序列级对数概率评分和可调探索参数，显著提升了大语言模型代理在顺序决策任务中的探索能力，超越了传统的温度采样方法。
en_tdlr: DORA Explorer proposes a training-free, inference-time method that enhances exploration in LLM agents for sequential decision-making by scoring candidate actions via sequence-level log-probability statistics and tunable exploration parameters, outperforming temperature-based sampling.
